title: The archive guard's 403 remedy names the spawner, not add_repo
why: Lane of PR 3136, round 1 reviewer (12:01 CST Nov 13): the new remedy names add_repo, but hooks/guard.py:6826 (rule agent-no-remote-tools) refuses add_repo for any agent caller, so a lane agent meets a second refusal. The archive call is the spawner's, and the spawner can run add_repo.
note: Todo, follow-up. After #3136 lands, change the remedy text to name the spawner. A change to a guard's text waits for its own review; not done on #3136 to avoid restarting its rounds.
